movement.instructions: Choose translation ONLY. View and action are chosen separately and execute simultaneously: retreating does not require stopping fire. Survive, explore and reach the exit. Never repeat forward movement against a blocked wall or after blockedMoves >= 2. Hold translation while the view turns toward a new opening, or retreat/strafe through known clear space. If a close centered enemy threatens you, evade through a clear rear/side passage. For a nearby closed usable door, hold while action uses it; hold while an opening door is still impassable, advance when passable. Approach distant doors/items only through clear space. Do not charge an enemy or revisit the same failed displacement. Stuck is feedback, not permission to invent a route.

criteria.hold: Stay in place while looking, aiming, using or waiting. Also when all translations are blocked.
criteria.advance: Walk forward into OPEN space or a passable door. Wrong for a blocked front or repeated failed forward moves.
criteria.retreat: Back away through OPEN rear space, especially from a close threat. Action can still fire.
criteria.strafe_left: Translate LEFT through clear side space. Does not rotate; action can still fire.
criteria.strafe_right: Translate RIGHT through clear side space. Does not rotate; action can still fire.

view.instructions: Choose camera rotation ONLY, independently of translation and firing. Positive bearings mean LEFT; negative mean RIGHT. Aim at a visible enemy or a nearby interaction surface: 3.5-degree corrections for errors under 10 degrees, 14-degree turns for larger errors. When there is no enemy, actively inspect unobserved headings and side openings rather than staring at a wall. If blockedMoves >= 2, rotate 45 degrees toward an open side or an unobserved heading. A side passage 90 degrees away needs more than one 45-degree turn. If taking damage with no enemy visible, search by turning toward a recently seen enemy's LAST KNOWN bearing, or scan unobserved headings. Memory can be stale: enemies may move or die. Avoid endless circles: heading observations and turnWithoutProgress describe repeated looking without travel. Hold the view while a faced door opens or a centered target is being fired at.

criteria.hold: Keep heading when aim is centered, waiting for a door, or walking a clear corridor already inspected.
criteria.aim_left: Fine aim LEFT +3.5 degrees for a small positive target bearing under +10 degrees.
criteria.aim_right: Fine aim RIGHT -3.5 degrees for a small negative target bearing over -10 degrees.
criteria.turn_left: Turn LEFT +14 degrees toward a visible off-center target or nearby left-facing surface.
criteria.turn_right: Turn RIGHT -14 degrees toward a visible off-center target or nearby right-facing surface.
criteria.turn_left_large: Look LEFT +45 degrees to inspect a side opening, search an unseen heading or escape staring at a wall. Do not hold the view against a blocked front.
criteria.turn_right_large: Look RIGHT -45 degrees to inspect a side opening, search an unseen heading or escape staring at a wall. Do not hold the view against a blocked front.

action.instructions: Choose equipment/interaction/fire ONLY. Movement and view are independent and happen simultaneously. Fire with usable ammunition at a visible enemy near the crosshair, including while retreating or strafing; never wait to lose health or walk up to a distant gunman. A modest simultaneous view correction can accompany fire; a far off-center or merely remembered enemy needs searching/aiming first. Use once when a ready door/switch has canUseNow=true and no missing key. Do not repeatedly use an opening door: that can close it. Wait while an opening door is impassable or just after triggering a switch; movement and view should hold to deliberately wait 600 ms. Move through once passable. keyAvailable=false means search for the key, not use/wait repeatedly. Equip an owned weapon only when useful; equipping the current weapon achieves nothing.

criteria.hold: Release action inputs when no visible target is aligned and no interaction is ready. Movement/view can still explore or search.
criteria.fire: Shoot a visible enemy near the crosshair NOW, even at long range and full health. Keep firing while the separate movement retreats or strafes.
criteria.use: Activate a ready door or switch ONCE when the use ray reaches it and a required key is not missing. Do not use an opening or already activated surface.
criteria.wait: Let an impassable OPENING door or newly triggered mechanism evolve. Choose hold movement and hold view for a deliberate 600 ms wait. Never wait for a missing key.
criteria.equip_fist: Equip fist. Only when it improves on the equipped weapon.
criteria.equip_pistol: Equip pistol. Only when it improves on the equipped weapon.
